title: AlphaSpec Score Submission (L1)
description: Cross-sectional output of any model (pandas, LightGBM, PyTorch, an LLM pipeline) handed to an execution runtime. You keep your research stack; the runtime handles sizing, rebalancing, risk, execution and the ledger. Carries either 'scores' (the runtime ranks and weights) or 'weights' (portfolio construction already done).

asOf.description: The last trading day whose information was used, in the market's local calendar. A score with asOf=T may use T's close and nothing later, and is executed no earlier than the next session. This is where look-ahead enters if anywhere.

scoreName.description: Model or signal name. Submissions with the same scoreName form one time series.

score.description: null = no valid score today (halted, missing data). Never use 0 for 'unknown': 0 is a real rank position.

weights.description: Target portfolio weights in [0,1]. Sum must be <= 1; the remainder is cash.

execution.description: Optional portfolio-construction settings. Omitted fields use the runtime defaults.

universePolicy.description: SUBMITTED: trade only from the submitted symbols. INTERSECT_UNIVERSE: intersect with the runtime-side universe; symbols dropped by the intersection must be reported back as evidence, never silently discarded.
